value.rationale: The exact equilibrium structure of an invariant polygon is a natural missing complement to the paper’s interior limit-cycle/center classification. Four independent quadratic counts would allow twelve, but a structural coupled-sign obstruction proves the sharp eleven ceiling. The result determines the entire boundary cardinality spectrum, identifies precisely the continuum degeneracy, gives the complete strict semialgebraic maximal chamber, and exhibits an open hyperbolic realization. This is useful boundary phase-portrait data, not an unmotivated computation or a claim about the full global dynamics.
